These paired binary/JSONL fixtures were generated by the actual C++ serializer
and record codec in `caster-encoder-controller`, using its native ordinary
contract harness. Files with `_swivel` / `_wheel` suffixes exercise split-board
protocol v4, node IDs 5/6 and only the active channel. Unsuffixed files retain
legacy combined v3/node 4 coverage. All use CASTLOG2 version 2, 116-byte
records, both caster identities, separate acquisition timestamps, independent
channel failures, sequences above JavaScript's exact-number range, and signed
64-bit wheel counts. The fixture MACs are synthetic and distinct per wheel/role.

They are serialized test inputs, not measurements from physical caster hardware.
Each binary file contains the same three samples as its JSONL file; the JSONL
also includes the firmware-generated metadata packet. Do not hand-edit these
fixtures to match a decoder: regenerate them with the controller harness when
the wire contract changes.
